trends.name: Healthy / Functional Snack
trends.summary: Snacks repositioned as nutrition delivery — fortification (calcium, iron, zinc, protein) plus play/interactive formats that make 'functional' feel fun, especially for kids.

trends.name: Wearable Supplement
trends.summary: Supplements as wearable patches — better absorption format meets fun, lifestyle-forward design. Not yet a category in China, but gaining traction in US/UK/EU. Barrière is the standout: turns patches into tattoo-like accessories.

trends.name: Sleep Support
trends.summary: Sleep aids reimagined as portable, single-dose formats — snap-open GABA nasal swabs with botanical extracts and exosome delivery. A bedtime routine you can carry in your pocket: home, office naps, travel.

trends.name: High Protein Snacks
trends.summary: Everyday snack formats (popcorn, chips, bars) repositioned around protein content — snack first, supplement second.

trends.name: Disruptive Format
trends.summary: Oral care escaping the toothpaste/mouthwash aisle — benefits (breath, probiotics, whitening) delivered through novel formats (candy, strips, bubbles) that make the routine itself fun and portable.

trends.name: Beautification
trends.summary: Skincare logic applied to the whole brushing regimen — hero actives with % printed on the front (The Ordinary style), serum-style packaging and texture. One consistent actives-and-% system across toothpaste, sprays and mouthwash.

trends.name: Disruptive Format
trends.summary: Coffee & tea escaping the hot-brew routine — nitro coffee concentrate and freeze-dried tea / fruit-tea blocks (also catching on in supplements like açaí powder) that make quality drinks instant, portable and fun.

trends.name: Playful Packaging
trends.summary: Freeze-dried coffee turned into a toy — gashapon machines, keyboards, collectible cubes — packaging itself becomes the reason to buy, gift and post.

trends.name: Beautification
trends.summary: Bedding that doesn't just touch your skin — it cares for it overnight. Probiotics, hyaluronic acid and collagen woven into fabric: your bed becomes the last step of your skincare routine.

trends.name: Deep Sleep Concept
trends.summary: A whole brand built around one idea — deep sleep. Every product, detail, package and ad starts from it, turning bedding from a category buy into a system you trust and re-buy.

trends.name: Sleep Aids
trends.summary: Beyond bedding — small sleep accessories building a micro-ritual around falling asleep: padded sleep belts filling the waist gap, weighted masks and hoods with botanical scent pouches, and pockets for disposable steam eye masks. Support, weight, warmth and aroma in one routine.

trends.name: Disruptive Format
trends.summary: Everyday formats re-engineered into something new — freeze-dried topping blocks, cold-water noodles — innovation you can see, feel and taste.

trends.name: New Concept
trends.summary: Instant foods that skip the heat — no hot water or microwave needed. Novel cold-prep tech and summer-friendly positioning turn convenience into the innovation story.

trends.name: One-Piece EVA
trends.summary: The whole shoe — or its sole — moulded as a single piece of EVA: sculpted shapes, embedded textures and statement finishes with almost no assembly. Lightweight, washable and design-led.

trends.name: Toyfication / Build Your Shoe
trends.summary: Shoes that double as toys — buildable, collectible and IP-collab driven (LEGO-style builds, swappable charm buckles). The shoe becomes a play platform: kids customise, collect and re-buy.

trends.name: Super Simple / Minimal Materials
trends.summary: Super simple shoes made with one or just a couple of materials — mono-material construction strips the shoe back to essentials: easier production, lower cost, recyclable by design, and an honest minimal aesthetic.

trends.name: 3D/4D Printing
trends.summary: Footwear printed in one shot — lattice midsole, cage upper and outsole fused into a single structure, no glue, no stitching. Chinese indie labels like 2AM turn this lab technology into radical sculpted silhouettes at accessible prices.

trends.name: Disruptive Format
trends.summary: Supplements moving beyond pills and powders — waterless oral mists and other portable, single-dose formats that make daily nutrient intake faster, easier and more intuitive.
